note: Findings that did not check out, or that limit what this site can honestly claim. Each row names how it was verified and what it costs the output. New rows carry the U- prefix (universal engine work); the original sport-specific registers live in docs/IRREGULARITIES.md, docs/CRICKET_IRREGULARITIES.md, docs/HANDBALL_IRREGULARITIES.md and docs/F1_IRREGULARITIES.md.

irregularities.title: OLBG cricket index was recorded under the wrong sport id
irregularities.detail: The repository recorded the OLBG cricket index as /betting-tips/Cricket/16. The OLBG sitemap lists Cricket as id 7 and 16 as Boxing. Fetching /Cricket/16 does render cricket tips because OLBG routes on the slug, but every event link on that page uses /7, and the article rail served on /16 is boxing content. All references were corrected to /betting-tips/Cricket/7.
irregularities.effect: No effect on scoring; the cricket source link now points at the canonical index.

irregularities.title: OLBG index pages mix absolute and relative dates
irregularities.detail: The server-rendered OLBG tips index shows some rows with an absolute date ('05 Sept 06:00') and others with a relative label ('Tomorrow 19:00'). A relative label cannot be resolved reliably from the HTML alone because it depends on the viewer's timezone and on when the page was rendered and cached.
irregularities.effect: Slate rows whose date is relative are marked date_basis 'derived' in the snapshots and are never used to place a match on the calendar. The scoreboard's dates come from ESPN, not from OLBG.

irregularities.title: ESPN prices come from a single sportsbook, not a market consensus
irregularities.detail: The odds block in the ESPN scoreboard payload carries provider.name (DraftKings on every fixture inspected on 2026-09-02). It is one book's price, republished by ESPN. It is not a best-price comparison and not an exchange price.
irregularities.effect: Every price shown on the site is attributed to the named provider in the UI and in the written tip. The de-vig is a proportional single-book de-vig, which is a weaker estimate of fair probability than a multi-book consensus would be.

irregularities.title: Seven OLBG sports have no key-less statistics feed
irregularities.detail: Horse Racing, Greyhounds, Darts, Snooker, Gaelic Football, Cycling and Handball have no free, key-less structured results feed on ESPN. Boxing/MMA has fight cards but no structured fighter-form feed, and Golf is an outright market across a full field rather than a two-competitor contest.
irregularities.effect: These sports are listed in the market directory with links to their OLBG index and their governing body, and never receive a generated prediction. Handball is the exception: it runs on the committed, source-tagged competition dataset and the specialist handball engine rather than on a live feed.

irregularities.title: ESPN's competitor.form and records are current, not as-of-match-date
irregularities.detail: For a match that has already finished, the form string and record summary attached to it describe the team as of the moment the request is made, which includes the result of that very match. Using them to grade history would leak the outcome into its own prediction.
irregularities.effect: scripts/backtest_universal.mjs discards both fields and rebuilds form, record, league baseline and head-to-head from matches that finished strictly before each fixture. Live prediction is unaffected: for an upcoming match the fields are genuinely pre-match.

irregularities.title: The retained price for a finished match is a closing price
irregularities.detail: The free feed does not keep an opening price history that can be reconstructed after the fact for arbitrary past dates; what survives is the close. A closing price is sharper than the price a bettor could have taken earlier.
irregularities.effect: The ROI figure in the backtest is an upper bound and is labelled as such wherever it is displayed. Hit rate and Brier score are unaffected.

irregularities.title: The build sandbox cannot reach ESPN or OLBG
irregularities.detail: Outbound HTTP from the development sandbox resolves only github.com, api.github.com and registry.npmjs.org. ESPN, OLBG, Open-Meteo and raw.githubusercontent.com all fail to connect.
irregularities.effect: Collectors and the registry/baseline builders are written to run in GitHub Actions, which has unrestricted network. Endpoint shapes were verified through a hosted page-fetch tool and captured as trimmed fixtures under tests/fixtures/ with a provenance block naming the endpoint and the read date.

irregularities.title: Model weights are hyperparameters, not measurements
irregularities.detail: How much each signal moves the log-odds, and how heavily the market price is weighted against the model, are chosen numbers. They are exported from engine/universal_engine.js as a frozen WEIGHTS object so they can be inspected and backtested.
irregularities.effect: The league baseline, form, records, ranks, head-to-head and prices are all measured facts; the weights that combine them are not. The distinction is stated on the method page and in the engine's own header comment.

irregularities.title: Curated rank is only published for a few competitions
irregularities.detail: ESPN sends competitor.curatedRank only for poll-ranked sports (mainly US college). For most leagues it is absent or set to a sentinel above 90.
irregularities.effect: The RANK-01 signal is recorded as missing for those leagues rather than being substituted with a table position, and the confidence ceiling drops accordingly.

irregularities.title: OLBG carries CFL American Football rows that ESPN does not cover
irregularities.detail: The OLBG American Football index prices Canadian Football League games. ESPN publishes no key-less CFL scoreboard.
irregularities.effect: CFL fixtures appear in the OLBG market directory but never on the American Football scoreboard and never receive a prediction.
